mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}), 0) AS turnover, IFNULL(SUM(o.status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}), 0) AS validOrderCount, IFNULL( IF(COUNT(o.id) = 0, 0, ROUND(SUM(o.status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.id), 2)), 0) AS orderCompletionRate, IFNULL( IF(SUM(o.status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}) = 0, 0, ROUND(SUM(o.status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}) / SUM(o.status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}), 2)), 0) AS unitPrice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS newUsers FROM orders o WHERE DATE(o.order_time) = CURDATE();

SELECT SUM(status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@TO_BE_CONFIRMED}) AS waitingOrders, SUM(status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@CONFIRMED}) AS deliveredOrders, SUM(status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}) AS completedOrders, SUM(status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@CANCELLED}) AS cancelledOrders, COUNT(*) AS allOrders FROM orders;
